description: Aggregate status manifest for the formal 4-scale, 6-model, seed1-10 Clutter campaign (240 runs).
notes: Read-only aggregate of 11 registered source manifests: seed1 is split into 40h (6 units) and 4h/10h/20h (18 units); seed2-10 each contain 24 units.
The aggregate references 240 unique result leaves and 41 unique historical/current Slurm array or recovery job IDs; it does not submit a Slurm workload.
Each unit retains its source manifest exact metrics, checkpoint, done/fail marker, expected protocol metadata, and absolute result path.

Source code roots differ historically between the long-lived repository and read-only snapshot 9afdede; all monitored artifact paths are absolute, while remote_root supplies the shared control-plane working directory.
